chunks: Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said: “There is no salat (prayer) except with taharah (purification).”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja‘far, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.بِطَهُورٍ: with purification; ritual purity required for salat
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: salat (prayer), the ritual worship whose validity is being discussed

ai.summary: Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام states that salat (prayer) is not valid without taharah (purification). The hadith establishes ritual purity as a necessary condition for the correctness of worship.
